freeInitialProfile.review: This Is My Father’s World / Audrey Assad。全部十二个正文阅读区域已由整曲转写逐字核对及原有上下文双窗口确认；首词This在两组已知歌词窗口夹到左缘，但词尾一致。另用两组无歌词提示的自由转写逐字且唯一确认This is my Father开头、真实首词正时长与词尾，两个起点在0.5秒内一致；不改变后续起点。

segments.text: This is my father's room, and to my listening ears,
All nature sings and round me rings,
I rest thee in the thought
Of rocks and trees, of skies and seas
This is my Father's world, The hobber's their carol's raise,
The morning light, the lily white, Declare their Maker's praise.
This is my Father's world, He shines in all that's fair.
In the rustling grass I hear Him pass, He speaks to me every day.
